propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner.run iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion_id, preventing activated project criteria from entering Round A/B workflow
Code-review gate YAML injects only 13 built-in overlays; project criteria injected dynamically at runtime never enter batch execution or get attributed to project.<name>
Code-review runner must serve both round_a and round_b with explicit Round-A-only fan-in to avoid double-executing project criteria and to keep retries deterministic
Active LLM-tier project criteria resolved via criterion_prompt_id must be assembled at gate_dispatch construction time and combined with req.criteria only when step_id equals round_a
Project criterion findings must preserve model-emitted tags and append logical criterion_id; missing or malformed prompts must fail loudly with located LLMError naming criterion and expected path
